quotes: Speed‑to‑power is a core reliability metric for U.S. industry and AI infrastructure; policy should meet the moment

letters.desc: esVolta highlights BESS's 12 to 18 month construction timeline as significantly shorter than the five-plus year average for gas plants, making it the fastest available option to close near-term resource adequacy gaps driven by large loads.
quotes: Battery energy storage is a proven solution to meeting near-term and longer-term resource adequacy and reliability needs, with a modular design that can be right sized based on need, and one of the shortest construction time frames of any resource (12-18 months).

letters.desc: The filing emphasizes connecting large loads quickly and efficiently as a shared goal aligned with the ANOPR and the Ratepayer Protection Pledge.
quotes: Southern Companies re-emphasize their support for timely and cost-effective integration of large-load customers to support growth and enable economic development and bolster the nation’s national security, in a way that protects existing customers, as called for in the Secretary of Energy’s Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking

letters.desc: The filers argue distributed capacity can be installed and aggregated into utility-scale assets in months rather than the years new generation requires, making it a bridge resource matched to the urgency of large-load growth.
quotes: Distributed capacity assets are installed today across critical footprints, are readily installable en masse, and may be aggregated into utility-scale assets on a timeline of months rather than years.

letters.desc: The filer directly rebuts the argument that ATT requirements would frustrate speed-to-power goals, arguing the opposite: ATTs on constrained systems speed up large load interconnection. Recent utility deployments demonstrate capacity gains achievable in under three years.
quotes: accelerated ATT adoption is more likely to speed the interconnection of new large loads to constrained transmission systems rather than frustrate speed to power goals.

ATTs can deliver meaningful increases in transmission capacity to facilitate the interconnection of large load in less than three years. While recent deployments by PG&E, Georgia Power and others validate this potential, utility adoption remains limited.
